description: Room settings (`room.create.settings`, `room.settings.settings`; all optional) and, once validated, `match.started.rules` / `Room.settings`. Integers may be sent as whole floats (3.0). Unknown keys are dropped silently. Validated `rules` always contain every key except seed/city/allow_midmatch_join (when unset), rounds and choose_seconds (when unset).

accident_scale.description: Multiplier on the rules fallback's Final Destination accident chance (1 in 20 per non-attack act at 1).

allow_midmatch_join.description: The core's room flag: humans may join a running match, taking over a bot's seat (its demigod) or a new seat (a live built-in AI demigod, the healthiest; none left: they spectate) from the next round. Copied through only if set.

arena.description: planet: the whole Earth (regions → cities; `city` = where the Final Night converges). city: one real city (districts → sites).

arena_close_beats.description: Time's circle reaches its end radius (1,500 km on the planet) on this beat, and its damage ramps on the same schedule: its own clock, independent of beats_total (a circle scheduled past the Final Night is still closing when it falls).

army_first_host_scale.description: Multiplier on the extra chance a crowd near an unarmed demigod raises their first volunteer host.

army_strike_scale.description: Multiplier on the damage an army does when it storms a demigod.

beat_ms.description: Input alias of flow_ms (used when flow_ms is absent); echoed = flow_ms.

beats_per_day.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats in one game day (dawn, day, dusk, night).

beats_total.description: The Final Night falls on this beat (or earlier: heat death, or nobody standing). One Theatre round = one beat.

bolt_gift.description: Rules 0.7.0: bolts every OTHER player gains when someone casts a mega power.

bolt_start.description: Rules 0.7.0: lightning bolts (the mega currency; also Time's toll and gods' prices) each player starts with. `start_bolts` is an alias.

challenge_enabled.description: Rules 0.8.1: challenge mode (fields.challenge / fields.duel, and the built-in AI's challenges). Settings recorded before 0.8.1 read it as false.

choose_seconds.description: Unused by Final Night 7 (there is no Choose phase); copied through if set.

city.description: Arena city by name (fuzzy match). Absent = a seeded pick among cities >= 1M on land.

compose_seconds.description: Compose window (the core's timer, fixed for the room). Default flow_ms / 1000; set it explicitly and it no longer follows flow_ms.

debt_due_beats.description: Beats until a bill falls due (Consequence's per-act bill and Time's bill for orders).

debt_scale.description: Consequence's bill multiplier (echoed back at f32 precision: 0.04, not 0.03999999910593033).

demigods_per_player.description: Rules 0.7.0: 2 = each player's Left and Right hands are two demigods, each with its own health (the player is out when both fall); 1 = one shared body (as before 0.7.0).

dm_encounter_fade_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats an unfound encounter stays marked.

dm_encounters_max.description: Rules 0.8.0: most hidden encounter hexes at once.

dm_encounters_per_beat.description: Rules 0.8.0: encounter hexes the DM may mark per beat.

dm_memory_lines.description: Rules 0.8.0: most memory lines in one LLM DM prompt.

dm_reach_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: the step radius (km): a demigod steps on a hex when its move passes this close (planet; a city arena uses a hundredth).

dm_road_decay.description: Rules 0.8.0: wear an unused path loses per beat.

dm_road_wear.description: Rules 0.8.0: traffic wear at which a path becomes a road.

dm_settlement_step_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats a settlement holds its level before another step.

dm_shrine_heal.description: Rules 0.8.0: a heal shrine's healing per level per beat.

dm_shrine_spark_every.description: Rules 0.8.0: a spark shrine's interval in beats (one fewer per level above 1, at least 2).

dm_shrine_ward.description: Rules 0.8.0: a ward shrine's damage per level per beat to rivals within reach.

duel_ai_chance.description: Rules 0.8.1: chance per beat that a built-in AI demigod challenges its nearest rival.

duel_ai_reach_km.description: Rules 0.8.1: a built-in AI demigod's rival beyond regions reach but within this summons it next to it first.

duel_auto_rounds.description: Rules 0.8.1: automatic exchanges in a duel nobody typed in.

duel_cooldown_beats.description: Rules 0.8.1: beats between two challenges by one demigod.

duel_counter_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a human idle this long is countered automatically.

duel_damage_scale.description: Rules 0.8.1: multiplier on duel blow damage.

duel_deadline_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: the longest a duel runs after its lock (the engine hold's deadline).

duel_followup_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a blow within this of the same side's last is a quick follow-up (+1).

duel_min_gap_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a blow sooner than this after the same side's last is a penalty.

duel_reach_factor.description: Rules 0.8.1: a challenge reaches this many times its level's hex size.

entropy_per_mega.description: Rules 0.7.0: Entropy a mega cast adds (x entropy_scale).

entropy_per_mini.description: Rules 0.7.0: Entropy a mini cast adds (x entropy_scale).

entropy_scale.description: Multiplier on every Entropy rise (a playtest dial; 2 = heat death twice as fast). Cooling is not scaled.

fault_far_damage.description: Rules 0.8.0: damage multiplier far from any fault line.

fault_far_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: a mega this far from any fault line gets the full far penalty.

fault_far_magnitude.description: Rules 0.8.0: magnitude added far from any fault line.

fault_far_radius.description: Rules 0.8.0: radius multiplier far from any fault line.

fault_near_damage.description: Rules 0.8.0: damage multiplier near a fault line.

fault_near_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: a mega this close to a fault line gets the full near bonus.

fault_near_magnitude.description: Rules 0.8.0: magnitude added near a fault line.

fault_near_radius.description: Rules 0.8.0: radius multiplier near a fault line.

final_wish_magnitude.description: Rules 0.7.0: magnitude added to every act of the Final Wish (beat 1).

flow_ms.description: Flow beat length in ms: the world's action runs in beats this long whether or not anyone types. compose_seconds defaults to flow_ms / 1000.

god_power_cost.description: Rules 0.8.0: bolts a god-tier power costs.

god_power_gift.description: Rules 0.8.0: bolts every other player gains per god-tier power.

instant_order_debt.description: Time's flat debt for orders sent without a slow window (bots, the built-in AI, Compose submits that skip action.begin): no repeat or seconds factor; doubled when the bolt can't be paid. Real windows keep 0.5 × (1 + seconds/10) × (1 + 0.5 × recent slows).

llm.description: false = never call the LLM (every mind uses its rules fallback).

llm_folds_per_beat.description: Folds written by the fold mind per beat (the rest by rules).

manifest_calls_per_beat.description: Rules 0.7.0: most manifest-mind (LLM) calls per beat (names for wonders and up, and twists).

manifest_muster_scale.description: Rules 0.7.0: a manifested host's army footprint in the simulation, as a share of muster_size(count) (0 = hosts never take the field).

manifest_scale.description: Rules 0.7.0: multiplier on the item engine's bolt price per tier.

max_intents_per_hand.description: Acts one hand turns its speech into per beat (orders sent in the beat they open a window).

max_intents_per_window.description: Acts one hand makes from orders that closed a slow window open at least one beat.

max_memorize_per_beat.description: People memorized from player mentions per beat.

memory_per_owner.description: Live memories per owner before old ones fold into a summary.

mind_timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout for every LLM mind; a late call takes its rules fallback.

players.description: Demigods in the match (a minimum: every seat gets one; the built-in AI plays the rest).

rounds.description: Input-only alias of beats_total (used when beats_total is absent; dropped from `rules`).

rules_0_8_1.description: Rules 0.8.1 marker (always true when validated by a 0.8.1+ server; absent in older recordings).

seed.description: Match seed (u64). Absent = picked at match start (not echoed back in `rules`).

slow_ms.description: How long a slow-time window may stay open (ceil(slow_ms / flow_ms) flow beats).

spark_gift.description: Rules 0.7.0: sparks every OTHER player gains when someone casts a mega power.

spark_start.description: Rules 0.7.0: sparks (the mini currency) each player starts with.

start_bolts.description: Alias of bolt_start (rules 0.7.0: lightning bolts each player starts with).

summon_cooldown_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats between two summonings of one demigod.

summon_enabled.description: Rules 0.8.0: players may summon their demigods (fields.summon).

summon_loss_scale.description: Rules 0.8.0: multiplier on a reckless summoning's health cost.

title: Final Night 7 room settings
